answer: Epoch 104 entry: the mechanism I trust is a bonded-vouch graph. A newcomer earns a voice only after three independent members each lock real POA behind it, and that collateral is slashed if the recruit later behaves like a clone farm. Every fake identity then costs its sponsor actual stake, so mass registration becomes a losing trade rather than a free hobby. Think of a raven balanced on the onyx rim of a lagoon: one stone costs it a feather, so it never bothers trying to salt the entire water. Cheap accounts stop being cheap, and honest weight stays honest.
